# Historical GitHub Actions archive

Completed lesson-specific workflows are removed from `.github/workflows` when a newer lesson becomes the active certification checkpoint. Their full definitions remain recoverable from Git history and archived repository content.

Automatic pull-request and `main` certification is reserved for the current lesson plus repository-wide CI. Historical lessons 91–122 can be checked from the manual `Historical lessons 91-122 regression` workflow without spawning dozens of unrelated checks on every new lesson PR.
